title: Refresh the tag-move rule example to v0.12.0 and de-brittle the location cites
description: Follow-up to QCLI-427, from quest-web re-measurement on 2026-09-30: the citation moved to 0.12.0 (opum-ai/quest-web#113, squash f12bd34, merged 18:44:21Z; verified here by re-reading their dev -- site-config.ts:222 version 0.12.0, page.tsx:273 exact, releases/page.tsx anchor now :186) about ninety seconds after QCLI-427 measured v0.11.0, which was accurate as dated. The landed rule names v0.11.0 as its example, and quest-web confirmed the set is the live-cited tags only (their gate:links fetches the built HTML; a departed citation drops out). Refresh the paragraph: example v0.12.0 with f12bd34 and date provenance, cite the expression rather than line numbers (their :121 -> :186 shift in one day), and state the live-only set semantics.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The move rule example names v0.12.0 with its provenance (their dev at f12bd34, 2026-09-30) and states that the set is exactly what quest-web rendered pages link, so a departed citation (v0.11.0) drops out.
Location cites use the rendered expression and files rather than line numbers, and the :121 -> :186 shift is recorded as why.
The required contexts (source-gates, Tracker integrity, lore check) report green on the PR head that lands it.
